detail: xchg esi, eax. EAX becomes the candidate base; ESI becomes the iteration index.
Saves the candidate base a second time.
Reads one dword of the stage-2 body. ebx starts at 0 and then steps by -4.
Writes the dword back after xor/add. This is the next in-place materializer.
Leaves the first transform when ebx reaches this value.
Second in-place dword loop. Still inside the stage-2 body.
Second loop walks backward four bytes at a time.
